properties.name: Cumbal (Narino)
properties.source: Nine veredas of the Cumbal indigenous reserve area (Tasmag, Quilismal, Boyera, Cuaical, Cuaspud Grande, Llano de Piedras, Cuetial, Guan, San Martin-Miraflores), layer 'Cumbal_veredas_wgs84' compiled by Javier Ochoa (CIP). Original source to be confirmed.
properties.attribution: Vereda boundaries compiled by J. Ochoa (CIP) for the CGIAR Science Program on Multifunctional Landscapes; original source to be confirmed.

properties.name: Pucallpa - Ucayali
properties.source: INEI referential census district limits (cartography of the V Censo Nacional Economico 2022; 'Distrital' layer, ide.inei.gob.pe): 11 whole districts of Coronel Portillo and Padre Abad provinces (Ucayali) and a clipped part of Calleria.
properties.attribution: Contains referential census district limits of the Instituto Nacional de Estadistica e Informatica (INEI), Peru (ide.inei.gob.pe); the limits are referential and have no demarcation value. Changes: districts dissolved into one outline, Calleria clipped, simplified. No licence is stated by INEI (to be confirmed).

properties.name: Northwestern Tunisia
properties.source: Tunisia - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB) v01, admin level 4, valid 2022-11-15; source Institut National de la Statistique Tunisie (INS), published by OCHA on HDX. Union of 7 sectors: Bousliaa, El Marja and Elles (Es Sers, Le Kef); El Ahouez Sud (Gaafour), Hammam Biadha Sud (El Krib), Chouarnia (Makthar) and Kesra (Kesra) (Siliana).
properties.attribution: Contains data from 'Tunisia - Subnational Administrative Boundaries' (COD-AB), source: Institut National de la Statistique Tunisie (INS), published by UN OCHA on the Humanitarian Data Exchange (https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-tun), licensed under CC BY-IGO 3.0. Changes: seven admin-4 sectors dissolved into one outline and simplified.

properties.name: Omo-Gibe Basin
properties.source: Ethiopia River Basins (eth_basins), World Bank Group, World Bank Data Catalog dataset 0040202: Omo basin polygon (79,549 km2).
properties.attribution: Contains data from 'Ethiopia River Basins', World Bank Group (World Bank Data Catalog, dataset 0040202), licensed under CC BY 4.0. Changes: Omo basin polygon extracted, reprojected from Adindan / UTM zone 37N to WGS 84, trimmed near the Kenya border (about 255 km2) and simplified.
